description: Defines the DistAutogradContext class for managing distributed autograd state, including functions for adding and retrieving send/recv autograd functions, managing gradients, and tracking RPCs within a distributed training context.

classes.name: DistAutogradContext
classes.description: Manages distributed autograd state, including functions, gradients, RPCs, and worker IDs for a single autograd pass.

classes.name: ThreadLocalDistAutogradContext
classes.description: Stores a shared pointer to a DistAutogradContext in thread-local storage for context management.

methods.name: DistAutogradContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the autograd context with a specific ID.

methods.name: contextId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this autograd context.

methods.name: addSendFunction
methods.description: Records a send autograd function with a message ID.

methods.name: addRecvFunction
methods.description: Records a recv autograd function with a message ID.

methods.name: retrieveSendFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the send function associated with a message ID.

methods.name: sendFunctions
methods.description: Returns all send functions for this context.

methods.name: recvFunctions
methods.description: Returns all recv functions for this context.

methods.name: addOutstandingRpc
methods.description: Adds a future RPC to the list of outstanding RPCs.

methods.name: runGradCallbackForVariable
methods.description: Runs a callback to potentially update the gradient of a variable.

methods.name: addKnownWorkerId
methods.description: Records a worker ID that this context has sent an RPC to.

methods.name: getKnownWorkerIds
methods.description: Returns the set of worker IDs this context has communicated with.

methods.name: accumulateGrad
methods.description: Records gradient accumulation for a variable.

methods.name: retrieveGraphTask
methods.description: Retrieves the current autograd graph task.

methods.name: setGraphTask
methods.description: Sets the autograd graph task for the backward pass.

methods.name: resetGraphTask
methods.description: Resets the graph task to allow a new backward pass.

methods.name: clearAndWaitForOutstandingRpcsAsync
methods.description: Waits for all outstanding RPCs to complete and clears them.

methods.name: recordGradEvent
methods.description: Records an event to mark gradient computation completion.
